Substations | Technical Procedure
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection 
checklist I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title 
block for the minimum oil Circuit Breaker 66kv:
 - Rated Voltage: 66kv, 
Rated current: 2500 A, 
Short circuit current: 3l.5 KA/1sec 
The first draft initiated by eng. Samer Ayad at Sabtia I Cairo, tested at 
24/8/02
Blower, complete set of tools, 
cleaning cloth, 
and
hydraulic oil if needed.
Check the oil level of the circuit 
 Breaker.
Change the oil every 5 times of 
 automatic Break due to short circuit.
Check tighten, Nuts, Bolts, etc.
Clean porcelain insulator surface.
Check the cabinet of mechanism and 
 operation
Lubricate the axis.
